description: Coriolis mass flowmeter, Modbus RS485: mass, volume and corrected volume flow, density, temperature, viscosity and concentration, totalizers, units, process and calibration parameters, diagnostics and Modbus configuration
source: Endress+Hauser, Proline Promass 100 Register information Modbus RS485, SD00154D/06/EN/02.13

sources.title: Proline Promass 100, Register information Modbus RS485

notes: Modbus RTU on RS485. Defaults: 19200 bit/s, even parity, RTU (registers 4910-4914).

Register numbers are those of the document (Modbus Application Protocol numbering, mass flow = 2007, Modicon 32007), sent one lower (address_base 1). Read with function 03, 04 or 23; write with 06, 16 or 23.

Floats are two registers. Register 4915 sets the byte order (0-1-2-3, 3-2-1-0, 2-3-0-1 or 1-0-3-2, default 1-0-3-2); the document does not define the notation. This map assumes byte 3 is the most significant, so the default is low word first; check one value on the device.
Measured values use the units set in the System units registers (2101-2150).
String parameters (device tag, unit texts, timestamps) are left out: the document gives their start register but not their length.
Do not write non-volatile parameters cyclically: they are stored in the HistoROM, limited to about 1 million writes.
Written from the manufacturer's document; not tested on a device.
